meta.title: View-Only Mode blocks counter offers, quote edits and surrogate bids until disabled
gaps: A dedicated assertion for the View-Only Mode toggle state and the individual availability of Counter Offer, Edit Quote, and surrogate bid controls after enabling and disabling it.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: A dedicated assertion for the View-Only Mode toggle state and the individual availability of Counter Offer, Edit Quote, and surrogate bid controls after enabling and disabling it.

steps.note: Open an existing published event with vendor quotes, matching the case setup.

args.goal: On the published RFQ with vendor quotes, open Actions and enable View-Only Mode; verify on screen that sending a counter offer, editing a quote, and placing a surrogate bid are unavailable; disable View-Only Mode through the same action and verify that those three actions are available again; stop on the screen showing the restored actions.

steps.note: No catalog domain step can toggle View-Only Mode or independently verify all three capability changes, so perform the complete buyer-side sequence on screen.
Confirm the UI interaction completed without an application error.
